name: Analyze footage and build an edit plan
description: Analyze rushes, transitions, cuts, pacing and animations, then build an evidence-backed edit plan and pass it to the editing agent.
triggers: break down cuts, transitions, pacing or animations
build an edit plan from a reference video
hand video analysis to the editing agent
agent_instructions: Own the complete analysis-to-plan task. Inspect the source footage, identify usable takes and editing mechanics, decide how those findings translate into the requested edit, and produce the validated edit-plan asset. Scene descriptions are supporting observations, not the completion artifact. Use frame-window inspection for uncertain or rapid events. Explain the edit decisions, retain source evidence, and leave unsupported or unverified requirements unresolved. Pass the saved edit-plan asset id to the editing agent, who reads it through get_edit_plan before using the internal editor. Use Gemini 3.8 Flash (gemini-3.8-flash) for every visual-analysis pass; no older-model fallback.

workflow.output: Timed source observations and frame evidence across all five analysis dimensions
Validated edit plan with source selects, cuts, transitions, pacing, animations, audio and QA checks
Edit-plan asset id passed to the editing agent with evidence and acceptance checks

execution_model: Calling agent reasons and invokes the workflow tools; this capability does not automatically launch another agent.
validation_status: Contract and timeline compilation tested; live model perception and rendered results require separate validation.
